name: For Further Study
summary: Historian Karnik awaits a package in Ironforge, tied to something epic. What has been seen so far makes further study worthwhile.

sections.title: Karnik's Library
sections.body: You are carrying the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers. He is usually in the library, reading at the back.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the package?
faq.answer: Historian Karnik awaits the Whelgar Relic Package in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
Historian Karnik is usually reading at the back of the library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
You are carrying the Whelgar Relic Package for Historian Karnik.

faq.q: Why does this need further study?
faq.answer: The matter is called epic, and what has been seen so far makes further study seem worthwhile. No further details are given.
